Glance 2026.10.08 improves administrator access.

- Add an optional administrator access service, selected by default when administrator authorization is available during installation.
- Support previews from elevated applications without repeated startup or update authorization prompts in installed use.
- Preserve the service during upgrades and remove matching legacy Core scheduled tasks through the installer.
- Improve portable authorization cancellation, process recovery and elevated 32-bit file dialog previews.
